description: Domanda di trasporto pubblico locale. Anni 2008-2013 is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Toscana. La domanda di trasporto pubblico locale è misurata dal numero di passeggeri annui per abitante ossia dal rapporto fra il totale dei passeggeri trasportati in un anno e la popolazione residente, considerando tutte le modalità di trasporto pubblico locale: autobus, tramvia, treni per il servizio metropolitano, ecc. Coverage: Regione Toscana. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Toscana. Its tags are 09trasporti, ambiente, comune-firenze, mobilita, opendata. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, PDF, XLS. The portal shows 2026-05-09 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
